text:
zach_prod: Quick flag from today's UI pass: in-panel help still references 'Callouts' but the Console now surfaces 'Highlights'. New users are confused. Also saw mixed 'cost per token' / 'cost per unit' language. Can we align?

maria_design: Yep saw that too. The help snippet we surface is just a raw excerpt from the docs site, so stale headings/words slip in.

leah_docs: Two short options: 1) central canonical glossary + generate excerpt snippets at build time using canonical terms, or 2) transform excerpt client-side with a small replace map. 1 is cleaner but slower to roll.

zach_prod: Leaning toward build-time canonicalization so analytics/search match. But we should have a quick patch we can ship.

tom_eng: For quick patch we can add a tiny client-side map in the console: {"callouts":"highlights","tokens":"units"}. When rendering snippets, run a regex replace. Low risk.

maria_design: Client replace is fine but mind grammar. "tokens"->"units" sometimes needs rephrasing ("token usage" -> "unit usage"). Also contrast issue: the snippet text color on dark mode is < 4.5:1. A11y flagged it.

aria_a11y: Confirmed: snippet body on dark theme has 3.8:1, header 4.0:1. Recommend bumping body weight or using slightly lighter background.

leah_docs: Longer term: add frontmatter 'canonical_slug' to docs headings so deep links point to stable slugs. During build we can emit a redirects.json mapping old hashes to canonical slugs. Example mapping: ```{"callouts":"highlights","quick-actions":"routes","token-cost":"units-cost"}```

zach_prod: That redirects.json can be fetched by the console at startup and used for two things: 1) rewrite help panel links, 2) emit telemetry when an old hash is used.

tom_eng: I'll add a small client SDK call: docs.redirect(hash) -> {finalHash, redirected}. Will also log docs_redirect event.

leah_docs: I'll add the canonical_glossary.md and produce the redirects.json in the next docs build. I'll standardize on 'Highlights' and 'units' as the canonical terms.

maria_design: I'll update the help panel UI to use shorter microcopy (title + 1-liner) and add an explicit "Open full docs" icon that opens in new tab. That avoids modal + screen reader focus issues.

aria_a11y: If you still open a modal, ensure focus lands on the H1/H2 and set aria-modal="true". Add a visible focus trap and keyboard close.

zach_prod: Ownership: leah_docs owns glossary + redirects.json, tom_eng owns SDK + telemetry, maria_design owns help panel copy + color fixes. I'll coordinate a canary next week.

ci-bot: ci: docs PR #1297 opened by leah_docs - "canonical glossary + redirects" (labels: docs, infra).

leah_docs: Draft PR created. I'll include the redirects.json example and a short migration note for any third-party links.

tom_eng: I'll add a tiny feature flag for client-side replace so we can toggle if anything breaks.

maria_design: I'll drop updated CSS and the microcopy draft into the PR as well.

zach_prod: Timeline: aim for merged PRs by Wednesday, canary through Friday, roll full by next Tue. Please @me on PRs.

leah_docs: On it. If anyone has pages that still use the old terms, paste links here and I'll update them in the build.

maria_design: I'll run a quick grep of the console copybase and paste results.

zach_prod: Thanks all. Small change but high impact for new onboarding flows. :rocket:
